response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, entrepreneurial initiative with GISCollective, and demonstrable fluency in AI-agent tooling and cloud infrastructure, but lacks explicit AI/ML product leadership, advanced degrees in AI, and evidence of strategic cloud platform innovation at scale required for a director-level AI strategy role.
strengths: Proven entrepreneurial track record with open-source AI-adjacent platform (GISCollective)
Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Broad technical fluency across cloud, DevOps, and multiple languages including DLang and TypeScript
concerns: No demonstrated AI/ML product ownership or published AI platforms beyond tooling
Lacks advanced degree in AI or related field; education ends at BS
Limited evidence of strategic customer advisory or cloud product vision at director level
